scope: One engine-free saved-artifact causal pass. All actual 16 selected B2/F0 activations, all invalidations and genuine TP fills; first TP per activation primary. No outcome-based selection.

A.release: Only original same-parent unfilled rights before original expiry, without prior actual BTC TP/trim/ordinary exit; quote/ACK/original limit/native margin eligibility must independently be known. Expired/permanently canceled rights not recreated. No control future fills as feature.

B.equity: Coherent actual post-SOL-TP/pre-BTC-debt marked equity only
B.peak: prior coherent event peak including pre-fill/pre-open
B.primary_scenarios: 90 most recent completed Bybit D1 paired SIMPLE returns with return end <= UTC(t)-1day
B.funding: fixed current notionals; sum absolute per-leg known-past funding rates for each completed UTC day, maximum over prior90 completed days; stress assumption, not realized cash
B.critical_unknown: UNKNOWN => NOT_ADMITTED; never zero; native margin separate

C.release: actual market-risk OFF by deadline only; no pending rehedge credit; absent causal state UNKNOWN
C.counterfactual_limit: After first actual BTC debt cut later market path is observation, not candidate continuing state

state_rules: TP/riskOFF: reconcile actual exposure, no automatic increase
riskON+budgetPASS: market risk retention prerequisite only through deadline
riskON+FAIL/UNKNOWN: retain not admitted; current reduce obligation remains
expired/TP/trim/ordinary exit/flip/flat: no restoration of closed rights
small lot/fill race: integer lot and actual fills authoritative
oscillation: no rearm admission absent edge/hysteresis/turnover contract
no_claims: No winner or ROI or DD guarantee
